This exposes any sensitive data stored in the database.",

        "when": "access to the bucket is requested",

      }
    },

      "stride": "Tampering",

      "component": "cloud storage bucket",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "The backup files are not encrypted" }
      ],
      "asvs": ["V8.3.1"],
      "cwe": ["CWE-353"],
      "plainLanguage": "Someone could modify the backup files and you wouldn't know until you try to restore a corrupted database",

        "given": "database backups are stored remotely",
        "when": "a backup is restored",
        "then": "the system verifies the backup has not been tampered with using digital signatures or secure checksums"
      }
    },
    {
      "stride": "Repudiation",
      "title": "Missing access logging enables undetected data breaches",

      "component": "cloud storage bucket",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "Database backups are written nightly to a cloud storage bucket" }
      ],
      "asvs": ["V7.1.1", "V7.2.1"],
      "cwe": ["CWE-778"],
      "plainLanguage": "If someone accesses or steals the backups, there's no log to detect the breach or investigate who did it",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Log all backup operations and access",
        "given": "database backups are created and stored remotely",
        "when": "a backup is created, accessed, or deleted",
        "then": "the operation is logged with timestamp, actor, and outcome for audit purposes"
      }
    },
    {
      "stride": "DenialOfService",
      "title": "Backups can be deleted, preventing disaster recovery",
      "scenario": "An attacker with delete permissions on the bucket (through compromised credentials or misconfigured IAM) can delete all backup files. This prevents recovery from database corruption, ransomware, or hardware failure, causing permanent data loss.",
      "component": "cloud storage bucket",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 5,
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "Database backups are written nightly to a cloud storage bucket" }
      ],
      "asvs": ["V1.4.4"],
      "cwe": ["CWE-284"],
      "plainLanguage": "Someone could delete all your backups, so if the database fails you can't recover your data",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Protect backups from deletion with versioning and retention policies",
        "given": "database backups are critical for disaster recovery",
        "when": "a backup file is targeted for deletion",
        "then": "the storage system prevents unauthorized deletion and maintains versioned backups per retention policy"
      }
    },
    {
      "stride": "ElevationOfPrivilege",
      "title": "Reporting team gains unauthorized access to full database",
      "scenario": "The reporting team, intended to access only aggregate metrics, can download full database backups containing raw sensitive data, PII, or operational secrets they don't need. This violates role-based access control and least privilege principles.",
      "component": "reporting team",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "The bucket is shared with the reporting team" }
      ],
      "asvs": ["V4.1.1", "V4.1.5"],
      "cwe": ["CWE-269"],
      "plainLanguage": "The reporting team can access the entire database through backups even though they should only see summary reports",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Enforce least privilege access to backup data",
        "given": "database backups contain data beyond reporting team's normal access scope",
        "when": "the reporting team needs access to aggregate data",
        "then": "provide sanitized exports or restricted views instead of full database backup access"
      }
    }
  ]
}
